parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
Lists only customers whose name contains every word of this text, ignoring case. A word matches inside the words of
the name, so "sup" finds "Acme Supply". Null or blank lists every customer.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
Lists only technicians whose full name contains every word of this text, ignoring case. A word matches inside the
words of the name, so "ost" finds "Bob Osborne". Null or blank lists every technician.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
Lists only vendors whose name contains every word of this text, ignoring case. A word matches inside the words of
the name, so "sup" finds "Acme Supply". Null or blank lists every vendor.

CustomerDto.description:
The details of a customer, supplied to create one or to replace the details of an existing one. A detail that is left
out or blank is stored as none, except the name, which is required.

CustomerResponseDto.description:
A customer as the API reports it. QuickbooksId is null for a customer that is not linked to QuickBooks.
Description, Contact, Phone and Notes are
null when none was provided.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable identifier of the failure.

detail.description: What went wrong and, where possible, what to change.

pointer.description:
Where in the request the fault is: a JSON Pointer to a body member, such as `#/name`, or `#/` plus a query
parameter name, such as `#/pageSize`. Only request problems have one.

ProblemError.description: One entry in the `errors` array of a problem response.

QuickbooksSyncResponseDto.description: The outcome of a vendor sync with QuickBooks.

TechnicianDto.description:
The details of a technician, supplied to create one or to replace the details of an existing one. A phone, notes or
QuickBooks id that is left out or blank is stored as none. The full name and the role are required, and the role must
be one of the configured technician roles. A technician is active unless bool TechnicianDto.Active is false.

TechnicianResponseDto.description:
A technician as the API reports it. QuickbooksId is null for a technician that is not linked to
QuickBooks. Phone and Notes are null when none was provided.

TechnicianRolesResponseDto.description: The roles a technician can have, as configured in the technician role settings.

VendorDto.description:
The details of a vendor, supplied to create one or to replace the details of an existing one. A detail that is left
out or blank is stored as none, except the name, which is required.

VendorInvoiceResponseDto.description: A vendor invoice as the API reports it.

VendorResponseDto.description:
